description: Broadcast a preview by its requestId. Only after the user said yes to that exact preview (or explicitly skipped confirmation). Publishes its note. If this call times out or is cancelled it still runs: never retry an Agentic Wallet requestId; check gang_status / the wallet history first. A wc-… requestId (wallet: "wc") goes to the connected wallet app, where the user confirms or rejects it (this call waits up to 5 min for them); calling it again with the same wc-… id never sends twice: it answers WC_ALREADY_SENT with sent and the txHash once there is one.
name: gang_execute
title: Send a previewed transaction
